content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

No-KYC digital product stores are a type of sovereign commerce infrastructure built for creators who need a platform-agnostic solution to sell their digital products. Unlike traditional e-commerce platforms that charge high fees and restrict access, no-KYC digital product stores are designed to be decentralized, secure, and highly customizable. This is made possible by NOWPayments, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-5|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]currency payment processor that eliminates the need for traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of no-KYC digital product stores is a combination of technologies that work together to provide a seamless user experience. These include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic cryptocurrency payment verification, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

No-KYC digital product stores are built for digital creators who need a reliable and secure way to sell their digital products without being locked out by traditional payment platforms. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or fonts, this infrastructure provides a platform-agnostic solution that allows you to maintain full control over your digital commerce stack. With no-KYC digital product stores, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products without worrying about platform fees or restrictions.
No-KYC digital product stores eliminate platform fees and restrictions, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components that make no-KYC digital product stores work together include NOWPayments for no-KYC cryptocurrency payment processing, GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Each component is carefully chosen for its security, scalability, and customization capabilities, ensuring a seamless user experience for both creators and customers.

The answer is simple: use no-KYC digital product stores, which provide a platform-agnostic solution for selling digital products. Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a no-KYC digital product store, follow these concrete steps: Acquire the necessary infrastructure components, including the Complete Builder Kit ($197); Set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; Configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; Integrate NOWPayments for no-KYC cryptocurrency payment processing; Choose a suitable order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets; Select a file delivery solution, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I handle customer support with no-KYC digital product stores?
No-KYC digital product stores are designed to be highly customizable, allowing you to integrate your own customer support solutions, such as email or live chat, to ensure seamless customer support.
What is the fee difference between traditional e-commerce platforms and no-KYC digital product stores?
At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad (10%) and no-KYC digital product stores (0.5%) retains $921.
Can I sell my digital products across multiple platforms with no-KYC digital product stores?
Yes, no-KYC digital product stores allow you to sell your digital products across multiple platforms, ensuring that you're not limited by traditional payment platform restrictions.
How do I handle order storage with no-KYC digital product stores?
No-KYC digital product stores use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, providing a secure and scalable solution for storing and managing orders.
Can I use no-KYC digital product stores with other payment processors?
No-KYC digital product stores are designed to work seamlessly with NOWPayments, but you can also integrate other payment processors, such as CoinPayments or BitPay, to expand your payment options.
